Choose a destination because of what you need to do. A file can pass through more than one of these places during a lesson.

Key words

Know what each place is for

Required
My DocumentsYour school file area, shown by your teacher. It may use school network storage.
Google DriveCloud storage for online files, sharing and live collaboration.
Google ClassroomLesson instructions, resources, assignments and handing in work.

Select a clue, then its destination

Trace one file’s journey

Classroom resource → download → your unit folder → upload → Classroom assignment. Downloading creates a copy. Uploading that copy does not submit the assignment: check the attachment, then use Turn in.

Checkpoint 03 · Folder blueprint

Build a route you can explain

First watch the teacher build a folder inside another folder. Then create and check your own route in File Explorer.

Key words
Watch the model

Inside, alongside or somewhere else?

Open My Documents, then create Year 7 inside it. Put each subject inside Year 7. Put this unit inside ICT & CS.

Maths and ICT & CS sit alongside each other. Unit 1 sits inside ICT & CS because it belongs to that subject.

Use the exact names and location your teacher shows. Your class may use bilingual names or Digital Explorers for the unit. Open existing folders rather than making duplicates.

Build it with your teacher

Required

Work in the real File Explorer. Open the parent folder before creating the next level. Tick after checking.

Help: create or move a folder

Open its parent folder, then use New → Folder or Ctrl + Shift + N. To move a misplaced folder, select it, press Ctrl + X, open the correct parent folder and press Ctrl + V. Check with your teacher before moving existing school work.

Map the Mission · Key terms

Use the question, meaning and example to connect each word to your practical work.

My Documents

Where am I keeping my school files?

The school file area your teacher has shown you for keeping your own files. It may use school network storage.

For example

Open your year, subject and unit folders to find the mission note.

Google Classroom

Where is today’s learning?

The online class space where your teacher shares tasks, resources and announcements, and receives submitted work.

For example

Open your ICT & Computer Science class and find today’s resource in Classwork.

File Explorer

How do I organise files in Windows?

The Windows application for viewing, opening and organising files and folders.

For example

Create a folder inside ICT & CS, then move the mission note into it.

Filename

Will I recognise this file later?

The name used to identify a file. A useful name describes its contents; the extension identifies its file type.

For example

mountain-lake.jpg is easier to recognise than image123.jpg. Keep the .jpg ending.

Download

Which way does the copy travel?

Bring a copy of an online file or a file created by a web page into your computer or chosen storage location.

For example

Download the mission note, then move it into your unit folder.

Upload

How does my saved file reach an online service?

Send a file from your computer into an online service. Uploading a file and submitting an assignment are separate steps.

For example

In Classroom, add the newest saved HTML file to the assignment.

Save

How do I keep my changes?

Create or update a file in a chosen location. Save Workbook downloads a new HTML copy containing your current answers and evidence.

For example

Save again after collecting File Navigator so the downloaded copy contains your badge.

Reopen

Can I return to the work I saved?

Find a saved file and open that copy again. Check that it contains the work you expected.

For example

Reopen the saved workbook and check your name, answers and File Explorer screenshot.

Screenshot

What does my screen evidence show?

An image of all or part of a computer screen. Include the area that proves the task worked.

For example

Capture the File Explorer path and Unit1MissionNote.txt together so your teacher can inspect them.

Folder

What belongs together?

A named container used to organise files and other folders. A folder can sit inside another folder.

For example

Year 7 contains subject folders. ICT & CS contains the folders for its units.

Folder path

Which route reaches the file?

The ordered locations leading to a folder or file. Each step tells you what to open next.

For example

My Documents → Year 7 → ICT & CS → Unit 1 is a model route to this unit.

Extension

What type of file is it?

The ending of a filename, such as .html, .jpg or .txt. It helps software recognise the file type. Changing the ending does not convert the file.

For example

Keep .txt when renaming the downloaded mission note.

Google Drive

Where are my online files?

Google’s cloud storage for online files. It can support sharing and working on the same live document.

For example

A group edits one shared Slides file through Google Drive.
